title: A Mission-Bound Authorization fixture of the bank demo
description: One case for the bank's payment API (request) or for its derivation rule, deriveUnderMission (derivation), in the layout of the atx-conformance fixtures: name, description, requirement, spec, keypairRefs, verifierState, expected, and the object under test.

requirement.description: The rule the fixture holds, with its section.

keypairRefs.description: Empty: the bank's access tokens are opaque and resolved inside the bank, so no key is involved.

missionIssuer.description: The Mission issuer the bank trusts: the bank itself.

resource.description: The payment API's resource identifier, also its audience.

declaredNarrowing.description: The authorization_details types the bank declares narrowing for, which the derivation rule narrows.

missions.description: The bank's Mission records, or null when the payment API has none to resolve against.

httpStatus.description: Payment API fixtures: the response status.

wwwAuthenticate.description: Payment API fixtures: the WWW-Authenticate value of a 401 or 403 refusal.

error.description: Derivation fixtures: the OAuth error of a refusal.

request.description: The access token record the payment API redeems, and the HTTP operation.

derivation.description: The Mission the derivation is under, and the requested authorization_details.
